meta.name: TECNOFEUDO SMART SAMPA
meta.brief: Vigilância urbana como arquitetura de extração: câmeras, drones e dados de pessoas alimentam uma tecnocracia; o sistema lê a cidade em calor e em pixels.

contract.concept: Vigilância urbana como arquitetura de extração: câmeras, drones e dados de pessoas alimentam uma tecnocracia; o sistema lê a cidade em calor e em pixels.
contract.audienceEffect: O público deve sentir Vigilância urbana como arquitetura de extração: câmeras, drones e dados de pessoas alimentam uma tec
contract.visualLanguage: Concept signal: verbs pulse, oscillate, accumulate, trace; motifs beat stamp, pendulum, stacked strata, drawn path; one dominant figure per composition over a quiet ground.
contract.formLanguage: Forms follow the hero generator of each composition; the structure layer keeps one module and one grid.
contract.materialLanguage: Light on a dark ground: lamp, signal; pendulum, wave.
contract.colorLogic: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
contract.spatialLogic: Canvas 3840x1920 (led); the hero sits on the focal zone, structure on the grid, information at the edge.
contract.motionLanguage: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.7774, 2% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: pulse, glide, breathe, pulse (the hero is hit on the beat and rings out; the structure answers a sixteenth later).
contract.typographyLanguage: Uppercase, one family; text only when the brief supplies exact words.
contract.temporalArc: a figure that returns to where it began; on every beat; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, turn, turn, turn.
contract.loopGrammar: cyclic: the loop closes on whole bars and every layer moves in whole cycles
contract.technicalStrategy: Generated without AI by brief_to_project.py from the structured brief; native pixels, deterministic seed, engine generators only.
contract.forbiddenShortcuts: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
contract.focalEvent: Os lasers infravermelhos do poste travam no chão e o contador de câmeras sorteia
contract.releaseZone: The ground field and the empty third of the frame; no layer fills it.
contract.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias

artBible.thesis: Vigilância urbana como arquitetura de extração: câmeras, drones e dados de pessoas alimentam uma tecnocracia; o sistema lê a cidade em calor e em pixels.
artBible.material: Light on a dark ground (industrial, glitch, aggressive); lamp, signal; pendulum, wave; no fake materials, no gradients that pretend to be objects.
artBible.space: Read from far away: heavy strokes, large forms, the hero on the focal third, information at the edge.
artBible.motion: Profile: smooth, eased; springy (zeta 0.7774, 2% overshoot); with a wind-up dip before each hit; 16 move(s) per loop of 4 bar(s), so the loop closes. Played as layer.mod spring curves (scripts/motion_profiles.py). Animation IR archetypes: pulse, glide, breathe, pulse (the hero is hit on the beat and rings out; the structure answers a sixteenth later).
artBible.dramaturgy: a figure that returns to where it began; on every beat; over 4 bars per composition, the set follows establish, turn, turn, turn. Tension: assertive; one dominant figure per composition; the ground field is the release.
artBible.color: analogous scheme, OKLCH hue 250 (cold steel and signal blue); one accent used for events only.
artBible.typography: No text unless the brief supplies exact words; if added: uppercase, one family, three sizes at most.
artBible.audio: Strategy structural: the music drives structure and scale, never every hit.
artBible.banned: neon glow, lens flares, partículas aleatórias
